Questions

Good to know

Anything else? Call us or send a message on Viber or WhatsApp.

Do all cars come with a driver?

Yes. Taxi, 7-seater and VIP cars always come with a driver — we do not rent cars without one.

How many people fit in the 7-seater?

Up to six passengers, with their luggage. It is ideal for families and groups going to the airport or on day trips.

Which VIP cars do you have?

Mercedes, BMW and Audi, always with a driver, for business meetings, events, weddings and special occasions.

Do you have super-luxury or vintage cars for weddings?

Yes. Exclusively for weddings we have super-luxury cars — Ferrari, Porsche Panamera, Audi Q8 — as well as vintage classic cars, always with a driver.

Can I book a car with driver for several days?

Yes. You can have a private car with its driver at your disposal from 1 hour up to 7 days: by the hour, for a day, two or three days, or up to a week.

Do you travel outside Athens?

Yes. Besides Athens, Nea Smyrni, Piraeus and all of Attica, we also do long journeys — for example a reserved car for a wedding in Thessaloniki.

How do I book a ride?

By phone on +30 694 222 2752 or +30 697 281 2233, or by message on Viber or WhatsApp. You can prepare the message with the «Book» section of this page.

Do you go to the airport and the port?

Yes, to Athens airport and the port of Piraeus, for departures and arrivals.
